question: what is gen1's absolute vertical datum at this site, measured against the 2008 MnGeo control the acquisition was itself validated on?

inputs.role: the 2008 MnDNR control transcribed from the eight MnGeo county validation reports, NAVD88(GEOID03)
MnGeo statewide tile centroid index, for naming the tile each mark falls in
per-swath alignment constants solved by coreg.align_swaths, gen1-internal

params.name: search_radius_km
params.why: supplied on the command line; the module has no default radius

params.name: cover_class
params.why: supplied on the command line; pooling covers measures canopy, not datum

params.name: mode
params.why: per_line = swath constants unknown; common_datum = align_swaths constants applied

params.name: ground_source
params.why: ASPRS bare earth as delivered; CSF is ~460 s/tile and the 2026-08-26 control run measured the ground-source effect at 6.5 mm median absolute over 16 marks

params.name: geoid_shift_m
params.why: both sides are NAVD88(GEOID03); assert_no_geoid_conversion checks it per mark and raises rather than converting

params.name: lateral_shift_m
params.why: NOT applied: a cross-epoch term has no place in gen1 vs its own control

params.name: res_m
params.why: corrections.json res_m; sets the radius ladder

params.name: threshold_on_the_screen
params.why: the screen statistics are printed for every mark and NOTHING is cut on them; the radius-spread screen was measured not to reduce site-to-site scatter (analysis/GEN1_DATUM_MODULE.md)

columns.tile: the gen1 tile the mark falls in
columns.on_disk: True when a file of that name was found in one of search_dirs
columns.n_marks: control marks falling in that tile, count
columns.marks: the control mark ids in that group
columns.path: the file found, or '' when the tile must be fetched
columns.point: control mark id (first spelling in the bundled CSV)
columns.cover: MnDNR land-cover class of the mark: L1O open, L2T tall weeds/crops, L3B brush/low trees, L4F forested, L5U urban
columns.km: distance from whatever the search was relative to, km
columns.tie_mm: surveyed elevation minus gen1 ground at the mark, mm; the constant to ADD to gen1. No geoid term (both sides GEOID03)
columns.sigma_mm: half the tie's radius spread over the pipeline-scale radii, mm
columns.line: point_source_id contributing the most ground returns within radius_m
columns.line_frac: that line's share of the ground returns within radius_m, 0-1
columns.n_lines: distinct point_source_id values within radius_m, count
columns.line_counts: every point_source_id within radius_m with its return count
columns.n: ground returns within the report radius, count
columns.slope_deg: |grad S| of the local order-2 surface at the mark, degrees
columns.relief_mm: p95 - p05 of return elevations within the report radius, mm
columns.fit_rms_mm: RMS of z_i - S(x_i, y_i) for that surface, mm
columns.radius_spread_mm: max - min of the tie across the pipeline-scale radii (res/2 to 2*res), mm -- how much the answer depends on an unstated window
columns.mean_mm: mean tie over that line's marks, mm
columns.sd_mm: sd of the ties within that line, mm (nan for n = 1)
columns.se_mm: sd_mm / sqrt(n), mm; the within-line SE, not the datum's
columns.resid_mm: common_datum only: the line's mean minus the datum value, mm -- how far the swath network's constant for this line sits from ground truth
columns.stat: name of the statistic on this row
columns.value: its value, units in the name

notes: 1004 transcribed rows -> 963 physical marks; 41 rows merged as the same mark published in more than one county report (exact match on easting, northing and elevation)
no geoid conversion: all 99 marks and the lidar are on NAVD88(GEOID03); checked, not assumed
28 of 66 tiles are on disk; 38 would have to be fetched and NONE was
headline: gen1 datum +47.8 +/- 29.6 mm (common_datum, 14 marks, 6 lines)
